title: CHAPTER 5: CLIMAX & RESOLUTION BREAKING THE TARGET FIXATION TRAP

segments.line: With only twelve minutes left on his clock, Pip sat on his living room floor. His
heart pounded against his ribs like a frightened bird trying to break free. If he ran
outside, target fixation might cause him to step into oncoming traffic. If he stayed
inside, his shaking hands might knock over a heater and start a fire. With
thirty seconds remaining, Pip remembered what the scientist said about target fixation and fear. You
cannot beat a bad thought by running away; you must pick your own target. He
pulled out his phone, opened a chat, and typed out a silly, embarrassing secret. He
confessed to his crush that he wore mismatched cartoon socks on their first date. He
tapped send just as his glowing forehead timer struck zero in a bright flash.
The crimson numbers burst into harmless little sparks and vanished from his forehead forever.
He made his biggest mistake on his own terms without ruining his life or job. His
crush texted back a laughing face, and the heavy weight was finally lifted away. If
a glowing countdown appeared above your head tomorrow morning, would you look in the mirror? Or would
you rather live in peaceful ignorance and let your mistakes happen naturally?
